description: This file implements an Apache JServ Protocol (AJP13) gateway module for the lighttpd web server. It handles protocol framing, request encoding, response header parsing, and communication with the backend using the AJP13 protocol. The module includes configuration merging, request creation, header encoding, and response parsing functionalities specific to AJP13.

methods.name: void mod_ajp13_merge_config_cpv(plugin_config * const pconf,const config_plugin_value_t * const cpv)
methods.description: Merges a single configuration plugin value into the plugin's configuration.

methods.name: void mod_ajp13_merge_config(plugin_config * const pconf,const config_plugin_value_t * cpv)
methods.description: Merges multiple configuration plugin values by iterating over them.

methods.name: void mod_ajp13_patch_config(request_st * const r,const plugin_data * const p,plugin_config * const pconf)
methods.description: Applies per-request configuration by merging global defaults and connection-specific values.

methods.name: mod_ajp13_set_defaults
methods.description: Sets default configuration values for the mod_ajp13 plugin based on server config.

methods.name: __attribute_pure__ uint32_t ajp13_dec_uint16(const uint8_t * const x)
methods.description: Decodes a 16-bit unsigned integer from network byte order.

methods.name: void ajp13_enc_uint16_nc(uint8_t * const x,const uint32_t v)
methods.description: Encodes a 16-bit unsigned integer into a buffer without byte order check.

methods.name: uint32_t ajp13_enc_uint16(uint8_t * const x,const uint32_t n,const uint32_t v)
methods.description: Encodes a 16-bit unsigned integer into a buffer, ensuring size limits.

methods.name: uint32_t ajp13_enc_byte(uint8_t * const x,const uint32_t n,const uint32_t v)
methods.description: Encodes a single byte into a buffer.

methods.name: uint32_t ajp13_enc_string(uint8_t * const x,uint32_t n,const char * const s,const uint32_t len)
methods.description: Encodes a string with length prefix into a buffer, handling special cases.

methods.name: handler_t ajp13_stdin_append(handler_ctx * const hctx)
methods.description: Appends request body data in AJP13 packets to the backend stream.

methods.name: void ajp13_stdin_append_n(handler_ctx * const hctx,const uint32_t n)
methods.description: Appends a specified amount of data to the backend in AJP13 format, handling request body streaming.

methods.name: __attribute_pure__ uint8_t ajp13_method_byte(const http_method_t m)
methods.description: Maps HTTP methods to AJP13 method bytes.

methods.name: uint32_t ajp13_enc_request_headers(uint8_t * const x,uint32_t n,const request_st * const r)
methods.description: Encodes HTTP request headers into AJP13 header format.

methods.name: uint32_t ajp13_enc_attribute(uint8_t * const x,uint32_t n,const buffer * const b,uint8_t code)
methods.description: Encodes an environment attribute into AJP13 format.

methods.name: uint32_t ajp13_enc_attributes(uint8_t * const x,uint32_t n,request_st * const r)
methods.description: Encodes various request environment details into AJP13 format.

methods.name: uint32_t ajp13_enc_server_name(uint8_t * const x,const uint32_t n,const request_st * const r)
methods.description: Encodes the server name into AJP13 format, handling IPv6 notation.

methods.name: handler_t ajp13_create_env(handler_ctx * const hctx)
methods.description: Creates AJP13 environment data for the backend request, encoding headers and connection info.

methods.name: int ajp13_expand_headers(buffer * const b,handler_ctx * const hctx,uint32_t plen)
methods.description: Parses AJP13 headers from incoming packets and expands them into HTTP headers.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ handler_t ajp13_recv_0(const request_st * const r,const handler_ctx * const hctx)
methods.description: Handles end-of-request condition or unexpected EOF during AJP13 communication.

methods.name: handler_t ajp13_recv_parse_loop(request_st * const r,handler_ctx * const hctx)
methods.description: Parses incoming AJP13 response packets, handling headers, body chunks, and responses termination.

methods.name: handler_t ajp13_recv_parse(request_st * const r,struct http_response_opts_t * const opts,buffer * const b,size_t n)
methods.description: Main entry point to parse incoming AJP13 responses, handling buffer accumulation.

methods.name: handler_t ajp13_check_extension(request_st * const r,void * p_d)
methods.description: Checks URI extension to determine if it should be handled by the AJP13 handler and initializes handler context.

methods.name: int mod_ajp13_plugin_init(plugin * p)
methods.description: Initializes the plugin by setting function pointers for server lifecycle and request handling.

methods.name: SETDEFAULTS_FUNC(mod_ajp13_set_defaults)
methods.description: unavailable
